release_notes: Autopilot now has a persistent schedule target, defaulting to 14 future release days, with 7, 14, 21 and 30 day choices on the home page.
Generate + Fill Schedule calculates the real schedule gap and supplies the batch size automatically instead of asking how many quizzes to make.
An optional Auto-fill switch checks the schedule after startup and every 30 minutes and starts another Autopilot batch when at least two target days are missing.
Automatic fills pause while production is busy, while YouTube is recovering, or until the YouTube destination has been explicitly approved once.
After the approved YouTube channel is verified to still match, trusted schedule-target batches no longer stop for the repeated destination confirmation dialog.
Schedule target preferences persist across restarts in autopilot-preferences.json; Auto-fill is opt-in so installing an update never unexpectedly starts a render batch.
